name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Separately authored solid Heart follows the slim V silhouette. Mirrored straight 45-degree lower flanks meet a convex quadratic tip; transitions from the side curves are tangent-aligned. The current upper lobes and notch are retained. Bounds x=2.4..21.6, y=3.25..20.75 remain centered. No interior counters or strokes. Not owner-approved.
